name: Stremio addons
author: Korie
description: Browse and play from Stremio addons. Add each addon's manifest address; catalogs, details and streams come from them, and nothing is saved on the server.

fields.label: Addons
fields.help: One addon per line: the address of its manifest.json. Streams play when an addon gives a web address for them; addons that only give torrents can't be played.
